objects.name: Swiss rail manufacturer Stadler refuses to pay $12.3 million ransom after cyberattack
objects.description: Cybercriminal group Everest is demanding 10 million Swiss francs ($12.3 million) from Swiss rail vehicle manufacturer Stadler after breaching a data exchange platform shared with one of its suppliers through compromised credentials.
